description: The items a design can go on: key, name, the blank it is printed on, price per piece, colors, sizes, and the print areas with their sizes in inches. Call this before quoting or when the customer asks what is available. Prices are per piece in US dollars; the first print area is in the price and each further area adds a per-piece charge shown here. Designing is free; nothing is charged until the customer orders on aipromodesign.com.
